name: Art
description: Create and edit images or generate short videos with Cindy's media capabilities. You can also invoke it directly with $cindy-art.
whenToUse: Use this plugin to create images, illustrations, avatars, posters, or other artwork; edit a generated image by adding elements or changing its style; generate a short video; or animate a still image.

gen_image.description: Prepare text-to-image parameters. Unless the user names a model, use the image model configured on the plugin page. Returns request.modelId/request.providerId; pass both unchanged to Core prepare as model_id/provider_id.

edit_image.description: Prepare parameters to edit or combine up to four images. Unless the user names a model, use the image-edit model configured on the plugin page. Returns request.modelId/request.providerId; pass both unchanged to Core prepare as model_id/provider_id.

gen_video.description: Prepare text-to-video parameters. Unless the user names a model, use the video model configured on the plugin page. Returns request.modelId/request.providerId; pass both unchanged to Core prepare as model_id/provider_id.

edit_video.description: Prepare image-to-video parameters: one image is the first frame; two are the first and last frames. Unless the user names a model, use the image-to-video model configured on the plugin page. Returns request.modelId/request.providerId; pass both unchanged to Core prepare as model_id/provider_id.
